title: 第二十六章 守望相助第二十五章 人情世故
slug: 诸天影视从四合院开始
content_zh:
在外教书这么多年，高飞扬心里面很清楚一些家长的小心思，他们总是渴望通过利益输送，让自己对他们的孩子多加照顾，往他们孩子的身上多倾斜一些教育资源，这让他感到很反感。
可是面前的这个叫叶晨的男孩却不同，他是自己教书这么多年遇到的最特立独行的一个，最重要的是高飞扬从叶晨身上看到了一种不张扬的善良。
高飞扬对于班级里新分来的学生强小娃早就有所注意，这个学生的家庭环境比班级里绝大多数的孩子都要差，日子过得很拮据，长发都快要披肩了，都舍不得花钱去理发，校服也一直都没花钱去换，就连微机课必备的鞋套，因为需要花钱购买，他也一直没准备。
教导主任肖方因为这些事情不止一次找到强小娃，有问责的意味，也有劝退的想法。毕竟这种一直不配合学校管理的刺头，哪怕是成绩再好，在管理者这边也是不受欢迎的。
林七二中是油田子弟高中，像强小娃这样另类的学生，很容易带偏学校的风气，在学生中产生不良影响，这是校领导不愿意见到的。
高飞扬一边帮自己的学生与学校这边搪塞，一边暗自头疼。他也不是没想过办法，甚至动过自己出钱帮助强小娃的念头，可是都被强小娃用生硬的态度给拒绝了。这让高飞扬如同老鼠拉龟，根本无处下口。
突然有一天，强小娃以一个崭新的面貌出现在了班级里，头发剃成了非常精神的板寸，校服也换上了，虽然不是新的，可是混在人群中，没有之前那么刺眼了。
看到这一幕的高飞扬心里面很震惊，他不知道是谁让强小娃有了这么大的转变。换成是其他学生，他也许会去刨根问底，可是在面对强小娃时，这一套明显就不管用了，这家伙三棍子都打不出个屁来。
不过高飞扬可以肯定的是，绝对是班级里的学生给他带来的转变，因为强小娃从不接触除班级以外的任何学生，即便是班级里的同学，他都基本不来往。
在那之后，高飞扬开始了对强小娃的暗中观察。好奇心驱使他迫切地想要知道是谁给这个小古板带来这么大的变化。
直到他看到强小娃和叶晨课间说话，以及他从走廊路过班级时往班里瞄的几眼，发现强小娃只和叶晨有过交流。
最重要的是高飞扬在这个木头疙瘩的脸上看到笑容了，这差点惊掉了他的下巴。
高飞扬从担任班主任以来，对班级里每个学生的家庭背景都做过了解。
在他眼里的叶晨，家里面最殷实，父亲是油田的二把手，母亲在油田开了一家最火的饭庄，他本人是班级里最皮的那个皮猴子，对学业基本没什么兴趣。
怎么看这两人都不该有多大关联，只是自己刚来到班里的时候，随手让这二人做了同桌，这可能是二人命运轨迹里为数不多的相交。
可就是这两人发生了奇妙的化学反应，成为了朋友，这有些太不可思议了。
白天支脉河事故发生的时候，高飞扬在人群外围注意到了自己的这两个学生，叶晨只是一个小动作，一个眼神，就让强小娃很快明白了他的意思，并且乖乖地去配合。
这说明什么？说明这二人已经发展成了挚友，形成了默契。这简直让高飞扬的好奇心爆棚，他迫不及待地想要去了解叶晨这个家伙，而下午的泡澡和饭局，明显就是最好的渠道，也是他乐于被安排的主要原因。
叶晨热情地招呼两人动筷，然后对着高飞扬笑着回道：
“高老师，您别算这个了，真要论起来，今儿个我还得感谢你们俩陪我泡了一下午澡呢，再说了，吃顿饭能花几个钱？这店是我妈的，我吃的是亲情价。

要是换成胡姨和我妈亲自来招呼你，估计你更不适应，所以由我来安排，是最合适的选择，咱们该吃吃该喝喝。”
经过白天一系列剧烈运动，再加上泡了澡，这三人的肚子早就饿空了，甚至强小娃的肠道还发出了响声，三人谁也没跟谁再客气，直接开启了干饭模式。
三个人边吃边聊，话题从上午胡悦落水的事儿转到了油田医院的排球赛，又转到高老师以前在魔都任教的那家中学。
聊到那边食堂的饭菜比林七二中强几个档次的时候，叶晨敲着碗沿表示强烈抗议：
“高老师，你可不能长他人志气灭自己威风，魔都本帮菜我也不是没吃过，浓油赤酱的，最主要的是太甜了，恨不得把糖罐子给打翻。
相比之下，我更吃得惯咱们这边的菜肴，尤其是咱二中食堂的酸菜粉条可是全校公认的好东西，哪是本帮菜能比得了的？”
高飞扬被叶晨怼得无言以对。他刚去魔都任教的时候，其实也吃不惯那边的菜，总觉得太甜太腻了，这让他适应了好长时间。
可是面前的这个家伙是怎么知道的？他今年满打满算也才十七岁吧？难道这就是家境殷实，让他眼界开阔的结果？
强小娃在旁边默默添了两碗米饭，连汤汁都拌着吃了，吃完之后把空碗整齐地放回桌角，自己倒了杯茶慢慢喝着，嘴角始终带着一抹淡淡的、满足的笑意。
他在叶晨身边是真的放松，叶晨不会给他那种让他肌肉绷紧的感觉。最重要的是叶晨真拿他当朋友，从来不会站在高高在上的角度，对他施以怜悯，这才是让他最舒服的。
楼下前台这边，前台服务员在安排好叶晨他们的包厢之后，就给自家老板娘的手机打去了电话。
牛玲玲在得知救了胡悦的三人正在自家饭店里吃饭，便和胡悦简单交代了两句，就急匆匆的往回赶。
她全程都没给杨松柏好脸色，因为在她看来，今天发生的事情，杨松柏属于绝对的过错方，不管是这个男人还是他们家，都太装了，这让她极为看不惯。
真要论起背景来，牛玲玲可是正儿八经的油二代，她父亲就是开拓油田的主要领导。
content_en:
After teaching abroad for so many years, Gao Feiyang is very aware of the little thoughts of some parents. They are always eager to take more care of their children and devote more educational resources to their children through the transfer of benefits, which makes him feel disgusted.
But the boy named Ye Chen in front of him was different. He was the most unique person he had encountered in all his years of teaching. The most important thing was that Gao Feiyang saw an unobtrusive kindness in Ye Chen.
Gao Feiyang has long been aware of the new student in the class, Qiang Xiaowa. This student's family environment is worse than most of the children in the class. His life is very tight, and his long hair is almost shawl. He is reluctant to spend money to get a haircut. He has never spent money to change his school uniforms. Even the shoe covers necessary for microcomputer class have not been prepared because he needs to spend money to buy them.
Xiao Fang, the teaching director, approached Qiang Xiaowa more than once because of these things, wanting to hold him accountable and wanting to persuade him to quit. After all, this kind of irritant who has always been uncooperative with school management, no matter how good his grades are, is not popular with the administrators.
Lin No. 2 Middle School is a high school for children from oil fields. Unconventional students like Qiang Xiaowa can easily deviate from the school's ethos and have a negative impact on students. This is something the school leaders don't want to see.
While Gao Feiyang was helping his students to negotiate with the school, he secretly had a headache. It's not like he hasn't thought of a way, and he even considered the idea of ​​providing money to help Qiang Xiaowa, but Qiang Xiaowa rejected them with a blunt attitude. This made Gao Feiyang like a mouse pulling a turtle, with nowhere to start.
Suddenly one day, Qiang Xiaowa appeared in the class with a new look. His hair was shaved into a very energetic shape, and his school uniform was also changed. Although it was not new, it was not as dazzling as before when he blended in with the crowd.
Gao Feiyang was shocked when he saw this scene. He didn't know who made Qiang Xiaowa have such a big change. If it were other students, he might have gone to get to the bottom of it, but when facing Qiang Xiaowa, this method obviously didn't work. This guy couldn't even beat him with three sticks.
However, Gao Feiyang is certain that it was definitely the students in the class that brought about the change in him, because Qiang Xiaowa never comes into contact with any students outside the class, and even with classmates in the class, he basically does not interact with them.
After that, Gao Feiyang began to secretly observe Qiang Xiaowa. Curiosity drove him to eagerly want to know who brought such a big change to this little old-fashioned man.
Until he saw Qiang Xiaowa and Ye Chen talking between classes, and when he glanced at the class when he passed by the corridor, he found that Qiang Xiaowa had only communicated with Ye Chen.
The most important thing was that Gao Feiyang saw a smile on this lumpy face, which almost shocked his jaw.
Since he became the head teacher, Gao Feiyang has learned about the family background of every student in the class.
In his eyes, Ye Chen has the most prosperous family. His father is the second-in-command in the oil field, and his mother owns the most popular restaurant in the oil field. He himself is the most naughty monkey in the class and has little interest in studies.
No matter how you look at it, there shouldn't be much connection between these two people. It's just that when I first came to the class, I casually made these two my deskmates. This may be one of the few intersections in their fate.
But these two people had a wonderful chemical reaction and became friends, which is a bit incredible.
During the day, when the Zhimaihe accident happened, Gao Feiyang noticed his two students outside the crowd. Ye Chen just made a small movement and a look, and Qiang Xiaowa quickly understood what he meant and cooperated obediently.
What does this mean? It shows that these two people have developed into close friends and formed a tacit understanding. This simply made Gao Feiyang's curiosity burst. He couldn't wait to get to know Ye Chen, and taking a bath and dinner in the afternoon were obviously the best channels., which is also the main reason why he is happy to be arranged.
Ye Chen warmly greeted the two of them to use their chopsticks, then smiled at Gao Feiyang and replied:
"Teacher Gao, don't forget about this. If we really want to talk about it, I have to thank you two for accompanying me in the bath all afternoon. Besides, how much does a meal cost? This restaurant belongs to my mother, and I eat at the family price.
If it were Aunt Hu and my mother who came to greet you in person, I guess you would be even more uncomfortable, so it is the most appropriate choice for me to make the arrangements. We should eat and drink. "
After a series of strenuous exercise during the day and taking a bath, the three people's stomachs were already empty. Qiang Xiaowa's intestines even made noises. None of the three people were polite to anyone else and directly started to eat.
The three of them chatted while eating, and the topic turned from the morning when Hu Yue fell into the water, to the volleyball match at the Oilfield Hospital, and then to the middle school where Teacher Gao used to teach in Shanghai.
When they talked about how the food in the cafeteria over there was several grades better than that of Lin No. 72 Middle School, Ye Chen knocked on the rim of his bowl in strong protest:
"Teacher Gao, you can't let someone else's ambition destroy your own prestige. It's not like I haven't eaten the food from the Magic City. It's rich in oil and red sauce. The most important thing is that it's too sweet. I want to knock over the sugar jar.
In comparison, I am more accustomed to the dishes here, especially the pickled cabbage vermicelli in the No. 2 Middle School cafeteria, which is recognized by the whole school as a good thing. How can our food be better? "
Gao Feiyang was speechless by Ye Chen. When he first went to teach in Magic City, he actually couldn't get used to the food there. He always felt it was too sweet and greasy, which took him a long time to adapt.
But how did the guy in front of me know? He is only seventeen years old this year, right? Could this be the result of his wealthy family, which broadened his horizons?
Qiang Xiaowa silently added two bowls of rice to the side, mixed with the soup and ate it. After eating, he put the empty bowl neatly back on the corner of the table, poured himself a cup of tea and drank it slowly, with a faint and satisfied smile on his lips.
He was really relaxed around Ye Chen, and Ye Chen would not give him the feeling of tightening his muscles. The most important thing is that Ye Chen really treats him as a friend and never shows mercy to him from a superior point of view. This is what makes him most comfortable.
Downstairs at the front desk, after the front desk clerk arranged the boxes for Ye Chen and the others, he called the landlady's mobile phone.
When Niu Lingling learned that the three people who rescued Hu Yue were eating in their own restaurant, she briefly explained to Hu Yue and hurried back.
She didn't give Yang Songbai a good look the whole time, because in her opinion, Yang Songbai was absolutely at fault for what happened today. Whether it was this man or their family, they were all too pretentious, which she couldn't stand.
If we really talk about the background, Niu Lingling is a serious second-generation oil worker, and her father is the main leader in developing oil fields.
